objective: Evaluate unchanged median-residual assay calibration on a fresh biochemical ROCK2 dataset with substantially broader held-out scaffold coverage.
selection_rule: Prefer accessible author structure/potency data and broader verified scaffold coverage. First candidate meeting primary methods/identity eligibility and fixed diversity checks is selected. No new model outputs used.
inclusion: Primary non-luciferase human biochemical ROCK2 IC50, exact positive <=10000nM; retain censored/missing/excluded rows separately.
Source structure identity must be independently reconciled. Tautomer equivalence may be documented explicitly with unique structural match; never map by potency alone.
Exclude exact IDs, isomeric and achiral structure identity shared with Phases17/18/20.
No exact held-out Murcko scaffold may match a scaffold from any previously evaluated17/18/20 compound. Report residual analogue similarity and dependence between chemically related scaffolds.
split: Unchanged SHA256(cryo-phase19-split-1900: + achiral Murcko scaffold) whole-group split. Calibration fills >=ceil(n/3); no label stratification or seed search.
model: UnchangedPhase17 protein/MSA/template and Boltz2.2.1 settings; two fixed seeds2101/2102. No experimental labels in inference bundle.
calibration: Median(observed minus predicted) fitted only on new calibration subset; no slopes, test fitting, best offset, model, seed or threshold selection. Phase17 source offset retained as separately reported diagnostic; Phase20 outcome cannot be overwritten by this experiment.
performance_gates: RetainPhase20 raw transfer>=20%MAE gain vsPhase17mean andrho>=.5; held-out calibratedMAE<=.5,biasmagnitude<=.25,gain>=20%vscalibrationmean,rho>=.5,no worseMAEthanraw. Bothmustpass for provisionalqualification.
uncertainty: 2000 paired scaffold-cluster bootstrap draws,2103/2104,conditional on calibrationfit. Report groupcounts,largestgroups,undefinedrankdraws,potencydistribution shift andpretrainingoverlapunknown.
spending: No GPU until primaryaudit, fixedeligible dataset, frozenplan, tests, freshallphasebilling. $10cumulativecap unchanged; max2.70fulljobreservation.
limits: Murcko groups are bookkeeping units, not proof of independent chemotypes.
Retrospective known inhibitors; training overlap unknown.
No cryoprotection, post-thaw function, toxicity or novel-discovery claim.
